Name: Shimri, of the Sons of Elizaphan
Summary: Shimri, of the sons of Elizaphan, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Jeiel, of the Sons of Elizaphan; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Every Levite family had men ready for the cleansing.
